author: KEXP
description: 'MAITREYA CORSO' finds artist Maya Hawke in careful contemplation of love and self-acceptance. In a recent visit to the KEXP Studios, she brings the tender set of folk-pop to life with an acoustic performance of "Bring Home My Man" and more.
title: Maya Hawke performs "Bring Home My Ma" & more Live on KEXP
